description: Queue durable still-frame evidence for layout/copy judgment. Returns immediately with {jobId, kind:'preview_frame', status}; then call wait_job(kind="preview_frame", id=jobId) to receive every presigned frame as an image. The immutable snapshot records geometry, layers, warnings, and whether the target was persisted, inline, or session scratch. A still cannot prove motion — use preview_clip or preview_component for animation.

composition.description: The composition to render. Absent ⇒ the project's ACTIVE composition — what create_render will encode. The response's `previewed.source` names what was rendered.

compositionId.description: Preview a SPECIFIC persisted composition of this project (create_render parity). Absent ⇒ the active one. A stale/foreign id is a 404 — never a silent fall-through.

imageFormat.description: Still format. Default jpeg — these pixels go to a vision model, where jpeg is equivalent and png costs multiples in bytes to store and move. Pass png only when you need full fidelity.

jpegQuality.description: JPEG quality (jpeg only). Default 70 — the quality the eval panel grades at.

scale.description: Render scale 0.1–1. Default 0.5, which is what this schema has always recommended for vision-bound looks. Pass 1 when judging fine detail — it costs ~4x the vision tokens.

session_id.description: Compose-session id: render that session's SCRATCH composition (what the session has been editing) instead of the active row. Ignored when `composition` is passed.

timestamps.description: Composition seconds to capture, 18 per request. The batch renders as ONE unit of work — one warm container, one source decode, N seeks — and that unit has a fixed time budget, so a larger batch is refused here rather than accepted and timed out minutes later. For a denser sweep, split it across calls; identical beats are served from the still cache, so overlapping batches are cheap.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: preview_frame

jobKey.description: Deterministic identity of the work (content hash of every input the result depends on). Re-enqueueing the same key returns the same job while it runs; a failed key revives as a fresh attempt.

status.description: running on a fresh/deduped enqueue; succeeded when an identical request already completed. Cancelled is part of the shared status vocabulary; identical cancelled work revives to running.

title: Preview Frame
